svg.title: Market Crossing | site plan
svg.desc: North-up plan of the market, its public passage, three double-loaded vendor halls, exterior ramp circuit and branch bridge to the forum.

g.aria-label: Exterior walking route and forum bridge

svg.text: The 120 stalls face three 4.65 m public aisles. Each bank steps back along Detroit Street.
Upper rooms and the glulam shell are projected over the ground plan. Dimensions in metres.

g.text: Arrows point uphill or to an entry.
